verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents Kintsugi publishing its own MCP server, which lets external AI assistants read its docs and OpenAPI spec. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing shows Kintsugi itself can connect to third-party MCP servers or use their tools, and a SaaS platform could plausibly ship such an AI feature, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
